fusions.name: Lowered Brow
fusions.desc: A short butt that deals 5 damage and leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Ledge Shove
fusions.desc: Heaves every enemy within 2.5 tiles aside, dealing 14 damage and knocking each back 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Planted Hooves
fusions.desc: For 5 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands.

fusions.name: Dug In
fusions.desc: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds. You have 6% more dodge chance.
